body.name: Skeptical executable-refinement handle
body.construction: Use a length-delimited parser for \(I\) and \(\Gamma\), a normalized arbitrary-precision rational datatype, exhaustive support classification by fraction-free linear algebra, and bag-local dynamic-programming replay; derive the untrusted generator from the same mathematical support domains while proving only the parser, checker, and decoder trusted. This specifies the starting technique and target objects, not a candidate implementation.
